entities.summary: Georgian Democratic Republic, a political institution in Georgia during Democratic Republic and Sovietization of Georgia (1918–1921). Grew from Georgian Democratic Republic proclaimed in Tbilisi and Red Army invades Georgia, ending independence. Led to the emergence of August 1924 Uprising.
